clue.text: County band's back, or group

indicators.note: the back of the word band is its final letter

parts.note: taken as written
a set is a group of things that belong together

explanation.surface: A local musician's back joins one ensemble or another in the shires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band's back' gives D, the last letter of 'band'. Dorset is a county on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Dorset is one of the English shires, an example of a county.

clue.text: Duck, as it happens, a shade of green

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, shaped like the letter O
a broadcast shown as it happens is live

explanation.surface: A colour chart notes that a duck, as it happens, is a shade of green.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a cricket score of zero, hence O.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a dull yellowish-green colour named after the unripe fruit.

clue.text: Cheese good in bread? Yes, when spread

indicators.note: the letter for good sits inside the shuffled letters
spread out means the letters of bread and yes are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether cheese is good in bread, and answers yes, when it is spread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when spread' shuffles the two words into SAEDERBY, which 'in' then opens to take G. 'spread' looks like buttering bread.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage Derby is an English cheese marbled green with sage leaves.

clue.text: Hair on face, in fact a cheek

indicators.note: in says the answer lies inside the run of words fact a cheek

explanation.surface: A remark that facial hair is, in fact, rather cheeky.
explanation.definitionFit: Tache is informal British shortening of moustache, hair grown on the upper lip.

clue.text: Nut to eat, while must be buried

indicators.note: something buried is enclosed, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to chew is to eat by grinding with the teeth
as can mean while, as in 'as I walked'

explanation.surface: An instruction that a nut is for eating while something else must be buried.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must be buried' makes the word for while go inside the word for eat; 'Nut to eat' reads as one phrase but splits after 'Nut'.
explanation.definitionFit: The cashew is a kidney-shaped edible nut from a tropical tree.

clue.text: Fish put down for chippy

parts.note: carp is a freshwater fish
to put down in a record is to enter it

explanation.surface: A fish recorded on the menu at the chip shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chippy' looks like a British fish-and-chip shop, which suits 'Fish', but it is slang for a woodworker.
explanation.definitionFit: Chippy is British slang for a woodworker who builds with timber.

clue.text: Belt goes up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the word is read from the bottom to the top

parts.note: one who goes or leaves parts company

explanation.surface: A belt is said to go upward, perhaps as a price rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap is a band of leather used like a belt to fasten or hold.

clue.text: Charming concoction of grenadine

indicators.note: a concoction mixes ingredients, so the letters of grenadine are blended anew

explanation.surface: A mixed drink made with grenadine is called charming.
explanation.definitionFit: Endearing behaviour wins affection, which is what a charming manner does.

clue.text: Like a roof that's condemned

definitions.meaning: a roof covered in slate tiles

explanation.surface: A roof that has been condemned as unsafe.
explanation.definitionFit: Slated means tiled with slate, and also British slang for savagely criticised.

clue.text: Sovereign, leader dispatched in error after uprising

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising up means the letters are read bottom to top
the leading letter is sent away from the word

parts.note: a clanger is a British informal word for a blunder

explanation.surface: A sovereign whose leader was wrongly dispatched after a revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: CLANGER loses its first letter to give LANGER, and 'uprising' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: Regnal is an adjective for things relating to a sovereign's reign.

clue.text: Part of reply, in general dishonest

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of someone's answer is, generally speaking, untruthful.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is telling untruths is being dishonest.

clue.text: Edge behind transport container

indicators.note: behind puts the piece for edge after the transport piece

parts.note: a cart is a simple vehicle for transport
a ridge is a narrow raised edge

explanation.surface: An edge sits at the back of a transport container.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartridge is a case that holds ink, film or a charge.

clue.text: Lever altered, adjusted

indicators.note: adjusted means the letters of altered are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lever has been altered and adjusted by a mechanic.
explanation.definitionFit: A treadle is a foot-operated lever that drives a machine such as a sewing machine.

clue.text: Describe old prairie

parts.note: ex- marks a former thing, as in ex-wife
a prairie is a grassy plain

explanation.surface: An instruction to describe an old prairie.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain something is to describe it so it is understood.

clue.text: Completely depressed Tory

parts.note: feeling down means feeling depressed
Tories are on the political right

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician who is utterly depressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Downright as an adverb means thoroughly or utterly, as in 'downright rude'.

clue.text: Philanderer giving wife nothing, remains unreliable

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: unreliable says the letters of remains cannot be trusted to stay in order

explanation.surface: A cheating husband gives his wife nothing and stays untrustworthy.
explanation.definitionFit: A philanderer is a man who has many casual affairs with women.

clue.text: Animal presented, fighter so hopeless

indicators.note: hopeless means the letters of fighter so are in a muddle

explanation.surface: A fighter so useless is like an unwanted animal gift.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the saying 'never look a gift horse in the mouth'.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift horse is literally a horse given as a present.

clue.text: Not sparkling, yet

definitions.meaning: describing water or wine with no fizz
nevertheless, as in 'it rained; we went nonetheless'

explanation.surface: Something is not sparkling, yet.
explanation.definitionFit: Still water lacks bubbles, and still is also an adverb meaning nevertheless.

clue.text: Second vote choice

parts.note: an election is a vote

explanation.surface: A voter's second preference in a ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: A selection is a choice picked from among alternatives.

clue.text: Lead missed in substandard card game

indicators.note: the leading letter is missing from the word

parts.note: crummy is informal for poor or substandard

explanation.surface: A poor card game in which a player missed leading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like the card-game term for playing first, but it means the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Rummy is a card game in which players collect sets and runs.

clue.text: Heal me, dry eyes initially deteriorating

indicators.note: deteriorating means falling apart, so the letters are broken up
initially takes the opening letter of eyes

explanation.surface: A plea for treatment of dry eyes that are getting worse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives E; 'deteriorating' rearranges ME, DRY and E.
explanation.definitionFit: To remedy something is to put it right, a synonym for heal or cure.

clue.text: Warm glow in plane journey punctuated by fury

indicators.note: punctuated means interrupted, so one piece breaks into the other

parts.note: a flight is a journey by plane
ire is anger or fury

explanation.surface: A furious passenger interrupts a plane journey's warm glow.
explanation.definitionFit: Firelight is the warm light given off by a fire.

clue.text: Draw with colour in layers

parts.note: a tie is a drawn game
red is a colour

explanation.surface: An artist drawing with colour in layers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' suggests sketching, but it is a drawn match.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arranged in tiers is built in stacked layers, like a cake.

clue.text: King, say, has month to hold on

indicators.note: to hold is to grip, so the month wraps round the other piece

parts.note: March is a month
taken as written

explanation.surface: A king has just a month left to cling to his throne.
explanation.definitionFit: A king is one example of a sovereign ruler, hence 'say'.

clue.text: River — rush to drain American one

indicators.note: to drain is to empty out, so letters are taken from the word rush

explanation.surface: A river rushing to drain an American's land.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhône is a major river flowing through Switzerland and France.

clue.text: Evacuated city, double big blow?

indicators.note: evacuated means emptied, leaving only the outside letters of city

parts.note: a clone is an exact double

explanation.surface: A city evacuated twice because of a big blow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big blow?' is a playful definition: a wind that blows hard.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent rotating storm is literally a big wind that blows.

clue.text: European means of payment discussed?

indicators.note: discussed means talked about, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a cheque is a written order to pay money

explanation.surface: A European's method of payment under discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from the Czech Republic is a European.

clue.text: Speak on religion and theological events, primarily

indicators.note: primarily means first, so each word gives its opening letter

explanation.surface: A call to give a talk on religion and theological events.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to speak formally and at length.

clue.text: Conversation in nightclub sure ridiculous!

parts.note: a disco is a dance club

indicators.note: ridiculous says the letters of sure are made absurd by rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at trying to talk in a nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: Discourse is written or spoken communication, a talk or conversation.

clue.text: I am on time for photograph

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone announces they are on time for a photograph.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph captures a picture, which is a visual representation.

clue.text: Stop! Unrestricted zone — move on out

parts.note: free means without restriction

indicators.note: move combines with out to say some letters leave the word zone
out completes the instruction to take letters away from zone

explanation.surface: A police order to stop, the zone is open, move on out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'move on out' sounds like moving along, but says ON is removed from ZONE to leave ZE.
explanation.definitionFit: Freeze! is a command to halt and stay motionless.

clue.text: Almost get stuck in back door like this?

indicators.note: stuck in places one piece inside another

parts.note: hind means rear or back, as in hind legs

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter of get is dropped

explanation.surface: Getting stuck in a back door almost.
explanation.definitionFit: A door is typically mounted on pivoting joints so it can swing.
